REGIONAL BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER JOB SUMMARY An established insurance brokerage is seeking a results-driven Regional Business Development Manager to drive new business growth in Trinidad and Tobago and lead the expansion of the company's footprint into Guyana, Suriname and the wider Caribbean. The role owns the regional growth agenda: identifying, developing and closing new corporate client opportunities, building strategic partnerships in new markets, and growing revenue from existing clients. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES New Business Development (Local) - Identify, prospect and qualify new corporate, institutional and public sector clients through research, networking, referrals and outreach. - Build and manage a strong sales pipeline from lead generation through needs assessment, proposal, negotiation and close. - Work with internal technical teams to develop tailored client proposals and solutions. - Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities within the existing client base. Regional Expansion (Guyana, Suriname & Caribbean) - Research target regional markets, including market size, competitors, client needs, distribution channels and regulatory requirements. - Develop and execute go-to-market plans for priority markets, beginning with Guyana and Suriname. - Build relationships with key decision-makers, business associations, chambers of commerce, insurers, intermediaries and potential local partners. - Identify and evaluate partnership, alliance and joint venture opportunities to support market entry. - Travel regularly within the region to meet prospects, partners and clients. Client Relationships & Market Presence - Build long-term, trusted relationships with client decision-makers (HR, Finance, Procurement and Executive leadership). - Represent the company at industry events, conferences, trade missions and networking forums. - Gather market intelligence on competitor offerings, pricing and trends, and feed insights back to management. Planning & Reporting - Achieve agreed new business, revenue and pipeline targets. - Maintain accurate records of all sales activity in the company's CRM. - Prepare regular pipeline, forecast and market reports for senior management. EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Requirements: - Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Finance or a related field. Desirable: - MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business or Marketing MINIMUM EXPERIENCE - 7+ years' experience in B2B sales, business development or corporate account management, including senior-level client engagement. - Experience in insurance, employee benefits, group health and life - Experience doing business in Guyana, Suriname or other Caribbean markets is a strong asset. -Exposure to Latin American markets, including Venezuela, is an asset but not required. - Proven track record of closing corporate deals and developing new markets or territories REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES - Strong prospecting, consultative selling and negotiation skills. - Excellent presentation and proposal-writing skills, with the ability to engage C-suite decision-makers. - Ability to research and assess new markets, including regulatory and business environments. - Self-motivated, target-driven and comfortable working independently across multiple markets. - Proficiency in Microsoft 365 - Valid passport and willingness to travel regularly within the region.
